newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends higher, buy stops tripped late.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends higher, buy stops tripped late.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures closed up, with March bounding higher in late trade when chart-based buy orders were triggered, floor sources said.
A swelling export tender lineup encouraged early buying in Kansas City wheat and those gains later activated the chart-based buy orders.

Sri Lanka, Yemen and Pakistan were scheduled to tender for optional-origin wheat and Egypt was rumored to tender by next week for up to 500,000 tonnes. It is doubtful much U.S. wheat will be included but traders said the tenders were supportive.
KCBT wheat closed up 9-3/4 to five cents, with March up most at $4.05 per bushel and May 5-3/4 higher at $3.71-3/4.
